newsitem.title: USA: First Union share offer priced at $12.125.
newsitem.headline: First Union share offer priced at $12.125.

text.p: First Union Real Estate Investments said Friday its public offering of 3.4 million common shares has been priced at $12.125 a share.
First Union said it granted the underwriter for the offering, BT Securities Corp, an option to buy an additional 510,000 shaers to cover over-allotments.

James Mastandrea, chairman and chief executive officer of First Union, said net proceeds from the offering will be used to clear the company's oustanding balance under a $90 million credit line, reduce mortgage debt and for future development and acquisition activity.
